description: Find community tools, GitHub projects, and Microsoft AI products/features mentioned in the Microsoft AI Roundup. Returns tool names, descriptions, GitHub URLs, and the issue context where they appeared. Optionally filter by keyword to find tools related to a specific technology or capability.

limit.description: Maximum number of tool mentions to return (default: 20)

query.description: Optional filter — search by tool name, technology, or description keyword (e.g. "Copilot", "Azure AI Foundry", "agents")

name: find_tool_mentions
